name: AVI Limited
summary: AVI Limited manufactures, processes, markets, and distributes branded consumer products in the food, beverage, footwear, apparel, and cosmetics sectors in South Africa, other African countries, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Entyce Beverages, Snackworks, I&J, Personal Care, and Footwear and Apparel segments. The company provides tea, coffee, and creamer; out-of-home ranges; sweet and savoury biscuits; baked and fried potato, and maize snacks; personal care products, including body spray, fragrance, cosmetics, and body lotion products; footwear and apparel; and catches, processes, markets, and distributes seafood and farmed abalone.
